statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail remains in the low band because available pre-open NQ evidence shows substantial two-sided repair rather than persistent extreme-holding or verified failed-retracement continuation.
recommendation: Current Tail is 19%. Extreme oil, rates and geopolitical Stress persists, while the imminent U.S. cash open remains a conditional checkpoint whose directional persistence has not yet been observed.
headline: Low Tail before the U.S. cash open as NQ remains two-sided despite extreme external Stress
body: Available delayed NQ evidence places the contract near the prior-close area and well inside a wide session range after substantial two-sided travel. Fresh shared breadth context is conflicted: semiconductors are broadly positive while megacaps are mostly negative. Oil near $100, higher volatility and elevated yields keep Stress extreme. The first cash hour remains the key conditional Tail window.

lookbackSummary: Across the preceding 24 UTC clock-hour slots, published ChatGPT Tail ranged from 17% to 27% while Stress remained at 100%. A brief trend-down elevation at 08:00 UTC reverted through WATCH and low Tail as two-sided repair reappeared.
outlookSummary: The principal danger window is 13:20-15:00 UTC around the first post-holiday U.S. cash open. Current Tail is low; forecast Tail peaks conditionally at 33% in the 14:00 UTC slot only if the opening move holds an extreme and repeatedly extends after failed repairs. Early two-sided repair invalidates that elevated path.
